edges.reason: transfer amount parameter flows into transfer().
transfer recipient parameter flows into transfer().
msg.sender is used as the sender argument of transfer().
transfer() invokes _transfer().
transferFrom() invokes _transfer().
approve() invokes _approve().
spender parameter flows into approve().
_transfer() calls _tokenTransfer() to perform the balance updates.
_transfer() may trigger swapAndLiquify() when the threshold is exceeded.
swapAndLiquify() calls swapTokensForEth() for half of the balance.
swapAndLiquify() calls addLiquidity() with the swapped ETH.
_tokenTransfer() dispatches to _transferStandard().
_tokenTransfer() dispatches to _transferFromExcluded().
_tokenTransfer() dispatches to _transferToExcluded().
_tokenTransfer() dispatches to _transferBothExcluded().
_transferStandard() calls _reflectFee().
_transferStandard() calls _takeLiquidity().
_takeLiquidity() credits the contract in _rOwned.
_takeLiquidity() credits the contract in _tOwned when excluded.
_reflectFee() subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee() adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
_getValues() computes the tax fee.
_getValues() computes the liquidity fee.
calculateTaxFee() uses _taxFee in the fee multiplication.
calculateLiquidityFee() uses _liquidityFee in the fee multiplication.
_getRate() divides using supply derived from _rTotal.
_getRate() divides using supply derived from _tTotal.
_getCurrentSupply() reads _rTotal.
_getCurrentSupply() reads _tTotal.
_transfer() compares amount and contract balance against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer() compares contract balance to numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
_transfer() checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before swapping.
_transfer() checks that the sender is not uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer() enforces the _maxWalletSize recipient limit.
_transfer() reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take a fee.
_tokenTransfer() requires sender to be owner while canTrade is false.
_tokenTransfer() checks the botWallets blacklist for sender and recipient.
_tokenTransfer() branches on the _isExcluded flags of sender and recipient.
unlock() requires msg.sender to equal _previousOwner.
unlock() reads and clears _previousOwner.
unlock() compares block.timestamp to the stored lock time.
unlock() reads _lockTime for the timing check.
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner.
lock() computes _lockTime as block.timestamp + time.
lock() writes the computed value into _lockTime.
lock() stores the current owner into _previousOwner.
lock() zeroes out _owner.
time parameter flows into lock().
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership().
transferOwnership() writes the new value of _owner.
claimTokens() performs an ETH transfer of the whole contract balance.
ETH is pushed to the caller-configurable marketingWallet address.
clearStuckBalance() pushes ETH to an arbitrary wallet address.
claimOtherTokens() performs an external ERC20 transfer on an arbitrary token.
swapTokensForEth() invokes the router swap with block.timestamp as deadline.
The swap is executed through the uniswapV2Router interface.
addLiquidity() invokes router addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
The liquidity operation is executed through uniswapV2Router.
swapAndLiquify() transfers the marketing ETH share during the swap flow.
The marketing share is sent to the marketingWallet address.
swapAndLiquify() toggles the inSwapAndLiquify guard via lockTheSwap.
contractTokenBalance local is computed and used inside _transfer().
takeFee local is passed into _tokenTransfer() to control fee application.
newBalance local is computed and used inside swapAndLiquify().
airdrop() calls removeAllFee() before transferring.
airdrop() calls restoreAllFee() after transferring.
airdrop() performs a _transfer() with fees removed.
airdropArray() performs repeated _transfer() calls for each holder.
removeAllFee() temporarily zeroes _taxFee.
removeAllFee() temporarily zeroes _liquidityFee.
allowtrading() sets canTrade, gated by onlyOwner.
setMarketingWallet() sets marketingWallet, gated by onlyOwner.
excludeFromFee() sets _isExcludedFromFee, gated by onlyOwner.
includeInFee() clears _isExcludedFromFee, gated by onlyOwner.
The constructor sets the deployer as the initial _owner.
The constructor creates the Uniswap pair and assigns uniswapV2Pair.
The constructor uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) for initial balances and exclusions.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to be forwarded into _transfer via transfer().
The amount parameter is only an argument of transfer() and carries no independent semantics.
The spender parameter is a direct input of approve() and should be folded into it.
The newOwner parameter is exclusively consumed by transferOwnership().
The time parameter is only used by lock() to compute _lockTime.
The local is a temporary within _transfer and must collapse into that function node.
The takeFee local is derived in _transfer but consumed inside _tokenTransfer, so merge into the consuming function.
The newBalance local is only meaningful inside swapAndLiquify and should be folded there.
